lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, circular pixel clusters arranged in semi-regular vertical columns along the mid-to-posterior lateral flank. The clusters exhibit a grid-like spatial distribution with higher density in the mid-flank region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a series of anchor nodes across the visible lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal linear features are visible on the upper flank, displaying a sharp vertical gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal side of the ridge and shadowed lower luminance immediately ventral.

other_distinctive_markers: A remora (Echeneidae) is attached to the distal portion of the right pectoral fin, visible as a distinct high-contrast elongated silhouette against the fin's surface.
